# NSPanel HAUI 0.4.6

A patch release that fixes the Marketplace's minimum-version check. The
repository declared the minimum Home Assistant version as `2026.11`, which
AwesomeVersion cannot order against an installed `2026.11.0`, so the
Marketplace reported "Home Assistant 2026.11 or later is required" on a
current install.

## Before updating

Nothing changes for existing panels: the release ships no firmware or display
changes, and the integration is installed through the Marketplace as usual.

## Fixed

- **The Marketplace accepts Home Assistant 2026.11.0** — `hacs.json` now
  declares the minimum as `2026.11.0`. AwesomeVersion does not order a
  two-part `2026.11` against the installed three-part `2026.11.0` (neither
  `<`, `==` nor `>` holds), so the Marketplace's version check returned False
  and reported the requirement as unmet. Installations on 2026.10 and earlier
  are still refused, as intended.
  ([#90](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/issues/90),
  [home-assistant/core#190737](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/190737)).
